{{Term/Store|Ripped and Shredded||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Armor Shop]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}}<ref name="BotW Rogaro"/><ref name="TotK Borrs"/>

==Features and Overview==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Ripped and Shredded is the resident [[Armor Shop]] of [[Goron City]]. It is owned by [[Rogaro]], who stands at the front desk at all hours.<ref name="BotW Rogaro"/> [[Pyle]] also works for the Armor Shop, directing travelers inside as they enter Goron City.<ref name="BotW Pyle"/><ref name="BotW Pyle 2"/><ref name="BotW Pyle 2">{{Cite|This is it. The {{Color BotW|Blue|armor shop}}.|Pyle|BotW}}</ref> Due to [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]] creating a [[Scorching Climate]] in the [[Eldin Canyon]], Ripped and Shredded has begun selling the [[Fireproof Armor]] [[Armor Set|Set]].<ref name="BotW Pyle 3"/><ref name="BotW Rogaro 2"/> Ripped and Shredded's [[Armor]] pieces are supplied by [[Rohan]], the local blacksmith, and they are crafted from [[Gem]]s sourced from throughout the Eldin Canyon.<ref name="BotW Rogaro 3"/><ref name="BotW Rogaro 4"/>

If [[Link]] enters Ripped and Shredded not wearing any of the Fireproof Armor, Rogaro will urge him to buy his Armor.<ref name="BotW Rogaro 5"/><ref name="BotW Rogaro 6"/> When Link expresses an interest in making a purchase at Ripped and Shredded, Rogaro states that the Fireproof Armor will help him stay cool in a Scorching Climate.<ref name="BotW Rogaro 7"/> After Link buys Armor, Rogaro will thank him for doing so.<ref name="BotW Rogaro 8"/> Should Link buy the entire Fireproof Armor Set, Rogaro claims he will have to procure a restock from Rohan.<ref name="BotW Rogaro 3"/>

==Trivia==
* Ripped and Shredded contains several examples of [[Hylian (Language)|Hylian]] writing.
** The sign above the entrance translates to "Armor."<ref name="BotW N/A"/>
** The signs by the Armor displays read as "Leg," "Torso," and "Head."<ref name="BotW N/A 2"/><ref name="BotW N/A 3"/><ref name="BotW N/A 4"/>
